content: This is the most informative pair I have seen: ligand 2 derives to jnk3~0.06, which is several times higher than anything else in this pool, and its distinguishing feature is unambiguous - an N-aryl carboxamide whose aniline carries a 1H-pyrazol-3-yl at the para position (C(=O)Nc2ccc(-c3ccn[nH]3)cc2). That is a hinge-binding azole presented on an anilide, exactly the arrangement real JNK3 amide series use. Ligand 1 is the inactive azetidine-piperazinium. Crossover would only include ligand 2 half the time and would join it to a random half of ligand 1, so instead I will rebuild ligand 2 feature directly on my working molecule, which is deterministic. Cut non-ring bond 11-12 to remove the protonated piperazine and graft the whole pyrazolylphenyl-carboxamide unit onto the azetidine C3 in its place. That removes the charge that was capping QED at 0.63 and installs the only motif in this pool with measurable activity.
